## Purpose and audience

Users, testers, and maintainers use this template to report a reproducible defect safely and route it to the right owner.

## Purpose / observed behavior

Describe the problem, expected behavior, affected stage/environment/version, frequency, and safe reproduction steps.

## Scope and impact

Affected organization context (use a non-sensitive identifier), EC2/S3/IAM area, role/persona, severity, tenant/security/accessibility/data integrity impact, and whether work is blocked.

## Evidence

Provide redacted logs, correlation IDs, screenshots, or test evidence. Never include credentials, tokens, external IDs, full policies, customer data, or exploitable public vulnerability details; use the private process in `SECURITY.md` when appropriate.

## Acceptance criteria / regression test

State how the correction will be verified and what must remain unchanged.
